description: Contouring to the head and neck, the Xtra-Comfort water base pillow provides exceptional support throughout the night. Easy to fill, the pillow includes an internal, leakproof water bladder that holds up to five quarts of water for customizable support for side, back and stomach sleepers. A layer of shredded memory foam tops the water bladder and is enclosed in a cotton shell for added softness. The adjustable water pillow measures 26” by 18” to fit standard pillowcases.
